title: 7 Pots of Ra: Hold and Win
summary: A released Hold and Win slot where I was the sole frontend developer and built the full client: UI, game features and backend integration (PixiJS, Spine, GSAP). The post walks through the hardest part: expanding the bonus board from 5x3 to 5x5 mid-sequence. The frame animation, grid, masks and off-grid elements move on one timeline, the scene rescales to fit the viewport, and the grid state is remapped from 3-row to 5-row coordinates at the exact moment the server switches

media.alt: Five-reel slot spinning and landing a cascade win
